title: Eddie Condon's role among the musicians
summary: Discussion of Condon as organizer, wit and non-virtuoso guitarist who hired New Orleans players at his club.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene
